programs.name: Master of Arts in Human Resources Management & Labour Relations (MA HRM&LR)
programs.feeNote: Programme fee per TISS admissions page: Sem I Rs 78,650, Sem II Rs 41,250, Sem III Rs 53,900, Sem IV Rs 29,700 = Rs 2,03,500 (tuition, exam, field education, IT, library, students' competency fund; Sem I includes Rs 11,000 refundable caution deposit). Excludes hostel/dining and student-borne costs of practicum/study tours. Batch year not explicitly labelled on page.
programs.intakeNote: Programme intake per TISS CAT-PG Admission Brochure 2026-27 and admissions page.
programs.placementNote: Official HRM&LR Final Placement Report 2026: 65 students participated, 34 companies, 58 HR-domain offers; highest Rs 66 L, mean Rs 28.69 L, median Rs 28 L; 20 PPOs. Not stated as audited.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting for Online Assessment on CAT
selectionProcess.weightage: CAT score 97% + 3% gender diversity (3 extra marks for female/transgender candidates)
selectionProcess.detail: Minimum CAT percentile cut-offs (overall and sectional) apply.

selectionProcess.name: Online Interview
selectionProcess.detail: Final merit list: CAT score 70% + Online Interview 30%.

selectionWeightage.note: Final merit weightage for MA HRM&LR, admissions 2026-27 (through CAT 2025). TISS reserves right to modify.
